clue.text: Portmanteau that, when heavy, hampers driver

clue.text: Mostly take ferry, say, near northwestern town

explanation.definitionFit: Crosby is a coastal town in Merseyside, in north-west England.

clue.text: Books manager representing non-U 24 across

clue.text: Rudimentary state of my robe to be altered
